description: This PHP source file defines the SaveSystemUserController class within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically in the Admin plugin. It manages the presentation logic for saving or editing system user data, including setting up Vue.js components with relevant properties based on the request context.

classes.name: SaveSystemUserController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for preparing and rendering the Vue.js component for saving or editing a system user, with social media authentication considerations.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties based on whether the operation is to create or edit a user and whether social media authentication is enabled.
